source_metadata.title: Comparative Risk of Hyponatremia Among Patients Treated With Second-Generation Antipsychotics

source_consistency_findings.details: Figure 1 repeats 88,741 in its final displayed box after 33,347 exclusions; the Results text, abstract, Table 2, and downstream analyses use 55,394 as the final cohort.
Results prose reports 31,723 (57.2%) inpatient, while Table 2 reports the same numerator as 57.3%.

source_consistency_findings.issue: Sensitivity-analysis significance differs from primary-analysis pattern
source_consistency_findings.details: The primary weighted analysis found only aripiprazole statistically significant; eTable 7 shows brexpiprazole and quetiapine also statistically significant under the 28-day grace-period sensitivity specification, and blonanserin statistically significant for the severe threshold with only 1 event.

missing_source_material: Supplement 2 (Data Sharing Statement) is referenced by the article but was not listed/provided as companion material in TBR/8-14 Clin Pubs.
extraction_limitations: ATOM extraction represents independently reviewable study claims and key quantitative findings; it does not atomize each baseline covariate in Table 2 or each diagnostic/ATC code in supplementary eTables 4-5 as separate atoms.
The supplied Supplement 1 was treated as supporting material under the same publication identity; no standalone supplement analysis was created.
